title: test_catalog hand-restates the new profile numbers — a retune that misses the fixture silently pins stale values in the unit suite
evidence:
append(&cat.node_types, Node_Type{id = "small_biz", display = "Small Business", kind = .Terminal, terminal_role = .Small_Biz, throughput_units = 20, port_capacity = 0, demand_weight = 2, era_introduced = 2})
append(&cat.node_types, Node_Type{id = "campus", display = "Campus", kind = .Terminal, terminal_role = .Campus, throughput_units = 150, port_capacity = 0, demand_weight = 4, era_introduced = 3})
// 5.11: the era-3 entries for the class analogues (mirror demand.json)
append(&e.entries, Demand_Entry{class = 0, source_role = .Small_Biz, sink_role = .Residential, volume = 1, default_lane = 1, selection = .Weighted_Random, demand_weight = 1})
append(&e.entries, Demand_Entry{class = 1, source_role = .Campus, sink_role = .Residential, volume = 1, default_lane = 1, selection = .Weighted_Random, demand_weight = 1})
detail: The story's profiles are data-driven (ODN-5), but test_catalog restates throughput 20/150, weights 2/4, and the era-3 demand entries by hand. A future balance tune editing data/*.json without the fixture keeps unit tests green on stale numbers (only the harness re-bless would move).
recommended_fix: Keep fixtures in sync on every profile retune (review note), or add a fixture-vs-JSON consistency check (e.g., a harness gate hashing both) so drift fails CI.
